name: Boobageddon
source:
In this story, you will follow the lead of our protagonist (their name is entirely up to you!); where a mysterious set of events lead to a multi-universal calamity. It just so happens that a cast of voluptuous beauties are along for the ride with you!

In this sudden turn of events, you find yourself wrapped in an unfamiliar world where fantastical beings co-mingle with the remnants of humanity. This is a world shrouded in mysticism and magic, where a coven of Witches operate outside the knowledge of humanity, leading to an imbalance in the powers that maintain reality.

It is your responsibility to unearth the mystery behind the calamity and, should you be resourceful enough, repair the shattered realms and restore order to reality once more! Who knows, maybe you might be able to have some lewd fun along the way - you only live once (or do you?!)

[From [url=https://boobageddon.itch.io/boobageddon]Itch[/url]]
translation:
在这个故事里，你将跟随主角（名字完全由你做主！）的脚步前行——一连串神秘事件引发了一场波及多重宇宙的浩劫，而偏偏有一群身材火辣的绝色佳人将与你一路同行！

在这场突如其来的变故中，你发现自己被卷入了一个陌生的世界，奇幻生物与残存的人类在此混居共存。这是一个笼罩在神秘主义与魔法之中的世界，一群不为世人所知的魔女集会暗中活动，致使维系现实稳定的力量陷入失衡。

你的使命便是揭开这场浩劫背后的谜团；只要你足够足智多谋，便能修补破碎的诸界，让现实重归秩序！谁知道呢，说不定你还能在旅途中享尽香艳艳福——毕竟人生只有一次（真的是这样吗？！）。

[摘自[url=https://boobageddon.itch.io/boobageddon]Itch[/url]]
